bounded-context.name: App
bounded-context.purpose: Downstream context; must reach ext only through its ACL gateway module.

term.name: Adapter
term.definition: The anticorruption gateway; the only atom allowed to touch ext.

term.name: Widget
term.definition: Holds a LegacyModel directly, bypassing the Adapter.

module.name: Gateway
module.description: The anticorruption gateway module; only the Adapter belongs to it.

seam.name: App ⇽ Ext (ACL)
seam.description: App protects itself from ext's model behind the Adapter gateway.
